content: Standard Django+gunicorn systemd pattern: dedicated non-root user, WorkingDirectory set to project root, ExecStart invokes venv's gunicorn binary bound to a unix socket or 127.0.0.1:port with --workers N, Restart=always/on-failure with RestartSec, WantedBy=multi-user.target for boot-time start. Gunicorn worker formula (2*CPU)+1 for I/O-bound; on Pi 4 (4 cores) that's up to 9, but for single-user low-traffic use 2-3 workers is sufficient and conserves RAM.
